messages:
ethan_sales: Heads-up  big-retail wants a Brexit-safe POC: UK-only data residency (they insist on London PoP), full subprocessor CSV, BYO-HSM, and a short contract clause for procurement. Any immediate blockers?
mira_se: UK-only data plane is doable. Control-plane locality to London is trickier  hosted control plane may still use global nodes. For strict contract wording they'd likely need dedicated control-plane or Private.
lucas_security: BYO-HSM only on Dedicated/Private. For hosted we can offer envelope keys with partner KMS but not customer HSM. Also procurement asked for an IP allowlist of subprocessors and DPIA evidence for UK. I'll prep attestation items.
ida_ops: Current UK subprocessors: AWS eu-west-2 (London), Azure northeurope (closest), CDN provider (fastcdn-uk). Will export CSV + contact points. Also note: some metrics vendor endpoints are US-hosted; we can switch to EU/UK instance for this POC.
redwood-bot: Ticket PRESALES-BREXIT-701 created. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/brexit-residency.
sam_ae: Commercial: customer asked for short-term dedicated capacity pricing (2 weeks) and whether we can offer a small trial discount. Any ballpark?
mira_se: Ballpark: for low-latency chat ~100 qps p95<300ms, recommend 1x A10 with warm KV cache. Dedicated control-plane + BYO-HSM add ~50-70% on top of hosted usage. Short promo: 20-30% off typical dedicated list is negotiable.
lucas_security: I'll assemble SOC2 + DPIA extract + an IP-allowlist-compatible subprocessors CSV. For telemetry: we can pseudonymize and minimize telemetry for hosted; full geo-isolation of telemetry requires Dedicated/Private.
ida_ops: Sample routing snippet for their infra team (presales doc):
```
routing_policy:
  tenant: big-retail
  data_plane_region: eu-west-2   # London PoP
  control_plane_mode: dedicated-lon  # requires dedicated purchase
  subprocessors_allowed: [aws-eu-west-2, azure-northeurope, fastcdn-uk]
  kms_mode: byo-hsm
  telemetry: minimal
  ip_allowlist: [34.210.1.2/32, 52.19.3.4/32]  # example
  fallthrough: deny
```
mira_se: Note: the "control_plane_mode: dedicated-lon" is not self-serve; needs infra + legal sign-off.
ethan_sales: Procurement also asked for a short plain-English clause we can put in an appendix. Can someone draft a 1-2 line starter?
lucas_security: Draft clause: "Redwood will process and store inference logs and model checkpoints only within the Customer-specified UK region during the POC. Control-plane functions may be routed outside the UK unless a Dedicated or Private control-plane is contracted; dedicated-control-plane terms subject to Schedule A." Will loop legal.
sam_ae: Action items: 1) ida to export subprocessors CSV + IP allowlist (today). 2) lucas to compile SOC2 + DPIA extracts and draft appendix for legal (tomorrow AM). 3) mira to confirm perf sizing + dedicated delta for 2-week promo (tomorrow afternoon). 4) ethan to propose dates to customer after docs are attached.
ida_ops: I'll attach files to PRESALES-BREXIT-701 and include ops playbook for tenant pinning.
mira_se: Perf sim queued; if they accept envelope keys we can try hosted pin first and offer dedicated as fallback. Will post numbers in ticket.
ethan_sales: Great, please drop artifacts here so I can hand to procurement. If legal needs escalation, ping me. :handshake:
